# Turn a product photo into an AI video ad — Seedance 2.5 or Kling 4

**One to three product photos become a multi-shot product video with the label kept exact and the real packshot on the last second.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_c291f75e56b7.webp" alt="Three product photos of black wireless earbuds become one hero still on a stone pedestal, then a product video where the earbuds float and settle into their case." width="480"></p>

Turn a product photo into a product video ad that keeps the real product. Builds TikTok, Reels, TikTok Shop b-roll and listing videos from one to three product photos: a product truth sheet (label text letter by letter, colours, parts), a cut-out, a hero still, an 8–12 panel storyboard sheet, then one multi-shot Seedance 2.5 or Kling 4 clip with a PRODUCT LOCK block, a repair pass on drifting shots, and the real packshot composited on the last second. Formats: hands-only ASMR unboxing, macro pour or texture, ingredient burst or exploded view, product in use, 360° loop, product in a hand, apparel try-on. Never ships a Ken Burns slideshow. Use when someone has product photos and wants a product video, packshot animation, unboxing, ASMR product video, listing video or AI b-roll without filming. NOT for a person talking about the product (use ai-ugc-ad-video), TikTok Shop presenter videos (use tiktok-shop-video), or still listing images (use a product-photo skill).

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill product-photo-to-video                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills product-photo-to-video --agent github-copilot --scope user
# or all 78 skills as a Claude Code plugin:
claude plugin marketplace add vargHQ/skills
claude plugin install varg@varg
```

| | |
|---|---|
| Makes | 9:16 MP4 product video, 1:1 or 16:9 cut |
| Needs | a varg account (OAuth through the varg MCP) or `VARG_API_KEY` |
| Typical cost | ~$2.50–10 per 15 s 720p video incl. one repaired shot (estimate) |
| Uses | varg API, Seedance 2.5, Kling 4, Wan 3, GPT Image 2.5, Nano Banana 2.1, Bria, FFmpeg |
| Works in | Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot, OpenCode and other Agent Skills tools |
| Agent instructions | [SKILL.md](./SKILL.md) (v1.0.0) |

## Ask your agent

- "Turn ./bottle.jpg into a 15-second TikTok product video, three shots, label exact, real packshot at the end"
- "Make a macro pour video of my honey jar from these two photos, camera locked, label readable"
- "I need a 360° loop of our headphones for the product page, 1:1, no person"
